caption: The 16-byte input fills the 8-byte buffer with 41, overwrites saved EBP with 42 42 42 42, and overwrites the return address at offsets 12–15 with a0 84 04 08. The null byte at offset 16 is the extra byte strcpy adds.

spec.title: 16-byte input overflows buf[8]
spec.aria: Memory rows show the buffer filled with 41 bytes, the saved EBP overwritten by 42 bytes, the return address overwritten by a0 84 04 08, and a null 00 at offset 16.
